# Owner decision: ABSORB (not ALREADY). M3JDK master 927e79becaf9ea232c57e342d0d6c8918338db05 has the one-shot kernel jdk.internal.m3.hash.M3XxHash.xxHash64 (zero-allocation-hashing 0.16, exposed as M3LongHashFunction.xx(seed)) and no streaming state, no update(ByteBuffer), no file API: grep -lE 'update\(|Streaming|FileChannel|hashFile' over src/java.base/share/classes/jdk/internal/m3/hash = 0 files. "JDK owns fast implementations": the relocated streaming class carries NO second xxHash64 kernel; its lane seeds, stripe round, lane merge and tail are the owner's atoms (OWNER row: MRL helper extraction on M3XxHash, package-private), and the donor's one-shot API hash(byte[]), hash(byte[], long), hash(ByteBuffer) is NOT relocated because M3LongHashFunction.xx(seed).hashBytes(byte[] | ByteBuffer) already is that API (TOKEN rows map the donor tests' calls onto it through a declared helper; the differential proves equality case by case).

# Row kinds (columns kind, donor, target, arg, note): FILE donor path -> target path (repository root). PACKAGE donor package -> target package. EXTERNAL package kept as is (imports). TYPE donor type -> target type (whole-word tokens). UNNAMED donor path: the package line is dropped (default package, as every jtreg test of test/jdk/jdk/internal/m3/hash). NESTED donor path, nested type: the target is that nested type (SPLIT). LIFT donor path, sha256 of the exact donor block bytes, HEAD|TAIL: a top-level donor block copied into the split type. REPLACE donor path, sha256 of the exact donor block bytes, block file: the block gives way to the declared block (the owner's atoms). DROP donor path, sha256 of the line bytes: the line is removed. TOKEN donor path, token, replacement: whole-token rename in that file (never on a whole comment line). INSERT donor path, PREAMBLE|TAIL, block file. OWNER target path, pre_sha256:post_sha256, patch file: the one declared change of an existing owner file. OMIT / NEC: informational, blobs pinned, nothing copied.
